On this Moon colony, kids can't write their name in the dust.
Nobody tells the new kid why. They just go quiet.
Why ban a doodle? It's just dust.
I'm Max, I'm ten, and I'm bored.
So I wrote it anyway. Giant letters. Max is cool.
It looked amazing. But then the principal ran out with a broom.
He swept. He scrubbed. But the letters just stared back.
The robot vacuum tried too. It gave up and went to sulk.
Then a tourist bus rolled by, and everybody clapped.
Here's why. On the Moon there's no wind and no rain, so nothing ever wipes the dust.
A footprint up here lasts millions of years.
I'm eighty now, and Max is cool is on every tourist map.
So, don't write in the dust.
